facts.text: It is a landlocked country in Eastern Africa.

culture.text: Makishi masked performances are part of initiation traditions among communities in western and northwestern Zambia.
culture.sourceTitle: UNESCO — Safeguarding the Makishi Masquerade in Zambia

food.name: Nshima
food.text: A thick maize porridge accompanies relishes such as vegetables, beans, fish or meat.
